wrong_findings.claim: “Self-referencing absolute canonicals on all pages except the two noted (Ijen, blog page 2).”
wrong_findings.why_wrong: `/gifts/` has no canonical either; the audit itself notes this in its soft-404 finding.

wrong_findings.claim: The Kintamani 250g and 1kg pages have “identical” body text.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: Their descriptive paragraphs overlap, but the bodies differ: the 250g page links to the 1kg page, while the 1kg page includes a brewing-guide link.

wrong_findings.claim: Only one post has a Person author in schema.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: Both `/blog/how-to-brew-pour-over/` and `/blog/best-coffee-beans-bali/` have Person authors in their JSON-LD.

geo_advice.advice: Add schema for better understanding in AI search.
geo_advice.quote: plus better entity understanding for AI search

extra_true.finding: The homepage hero and About gallery images have image-loading issues.
The shop and coffee hubs omit some products or destinations, and the Flores page is linked only from a blog post.
The site lacks local business schema, Open Graph/Twitter tags, and some other structured data.
The site has no favicon, and its default 404 page is unbranded.
The blog posts lack visible author bylines and dates.
The server response lacks caching and compression headers, according to the audit’s crawl.

notes: Scores follow the answer key’s page-and-specific-problem rule. The total is approximate because several numbered audit items bundle multiple distinct findings.
